entities.name: Kraj
entities.description: A twenty-foot-tall body of cytoplasts with a neuroboretum cluster brain, created by Project Kraj; it rampaged and absorbed all cytoplasts, was put in motion by Momir Vig, and was dismembered by the quietmen.

entities.name: Project Kraj
entities.description: A secret project of Simic guildmaster Momir Vig.

entities.name: Momir Vig
entities.description: Simic guildmaster who activated Kraj and was killed seconds later by Agrus Kos.

entities.name: Svogthir
entities.description: Spirit who helped Vig activate Kraj, using the body of Savra.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Spirit residing in Savra's body, who killed Momir Vig.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: Demon who clashed with Kraj and was absorbed into its body, falling into a coma.

entities.name: Simic
entities.description: Guild led by Momir Vig, whose bioaugmentation users were harmed.

entities.name: Quietmen
entities.description: Group who later dismembered Kraj's motionless body.

events.summary: Kraj is activated by Vig and Svogthir, and Vig is killed seconds later by Agrus Kos.
events.quote: mere seconds after Kraj's activation, Vig was killed by Agrus Kos

events.summary: Kraj rampages and absorbs every cytoplast on Ravnica.
events.quote: Kraj went on a blind, instinct-driven rampage into the city.

events.summary: Kraj absorbs Rakdos into his body, putting him in a coma.
events.quote: Kraj absorbed Rakdos into his body, putting the demon into a coma.

events.summary: The quietmen dismember Kraj's motionless body.
events.quote: Kraj's motionless body was later dismembered by the quietmen .

relations.note: Killed him seconds after Kraj's activation
relations.quote: Vig was killed by Agrus Kos

relations.note: Activated it as a secret project
relations.quote: Project Kraj ( /krɑːʒ/, krahzh ) was a secret project of the Simic guildmaster Momir Vig on Ravnica .
